text_block_list.name: Cheers
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa, haa――

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
(So this is... the Senior Class...! Their 
raw ability is on a whole different 
level...!!)
—Loves-chan.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Ngh... L-Lara...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
(No way... right? After a race like that, 
she's already acting totally normal—)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"...I saw your resolve loud and clear, 
Loves-chan. Thanks to that, I've got my 
own fire back."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: That's why... thank you so much for today.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Alright. Next time we run together, I'll 
make sure I'm even faster.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Ngh...—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
(I need to become stronger too... Much, 
much stronger...!)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Miss Lala... Thank... you so much...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Mm. Looks like my body has finally 
calmed down a bit...
choice_data_list:
There's no need to rush. Let's just wait 
and see a little longer.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"...Right. In that case, if you insist, 
maybe I'll rest for just a little longer♪"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Loves Only You after the fierce battle. 
Her exhaustion lingered far more heavily 
after the race than we had anticipated...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Racing against the Senior Class veterans 
was proof enough of just how grueling the 
competition truly was.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Under these circumstances, achieving a 
result that leads to the next step should 
normally be cause for great joy, but—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching Loves Only You, I found a new 
sense of anxiety creeping into my chest—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...That night.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
“—And so, I'm heading back to the academy 
tomorrow instead, taking an impromptu 
break to relax in Kyoto♪”

text_block_list.name: Comments Section
text_block_list.text:
"That sounds like a good idea." "It was an 
amazing race, after all." "Loves-chan, 
aren't you a bit tired?" "Get some good 
rest!" "Great work out there!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Ehh? Sorry, did I look tired? Don't worry, 
I'm completely fineâª

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, next up is finally Hong 
Kong! Everyone's super excited, right?♪

text_block_list.name: Comments Section
text_block_list.text:
""Finally!" "Hong Kong, here we come!" 
"Charge~!" "Taking on the world at last!" 
"So exciting☆" "If it's Love-chan, she can 
win!""

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Uh-huh♪ Please keep giving lots of cheers 
to everyone's Loves, spreading her wings 
across the world!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Phew—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, it was a seriously tough race, after 
all, so the fatigue might be hitting a bit 
harder this time.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
So today, I'm gonna rest right after this♪ 
I've gotta make sure I recover properly.
choice_data_list: ...Yeah. Make sure you get plenty of rest.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Well then, good night♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: See you tomorrow~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After seeing off Loves Only You as she 
heads back to her room, I let out a deep 
sigh.
choice_data_list: (I need to get some proper rest too...)
(I need to get some proper rest, too...)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—And we're approaching the final stretch! 
Japan's Loves Only You makes her move!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Leaping straight into the lead—wait, 
what's this!? Loves Only You is 
decelerating rapidly! What on earth 
happened!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I run desperately toward Loves Only You, 
who has collapsed on the track. Yet I 
can't move forward. As if my feet are 
stuck in deep mud.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Impatience scorches my back. Terror 
threatens to make my head burst. Regret 
becomes needles piercing through my entire 
body from the inside.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even so, I can't reach her. Loves Only 
You's silhouette melts deeper and deeper 
into the darkness――

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And with that, I hastily jumped out of 
bed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Relief that what just happened was merely 
a nightmare. Soon, however, as if to 
overwrite that relief, a heavy anxiety 
began to surface.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days after the Queen Elizabeth II 
Cup—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Then let's do cross-training again today. 
First up is some light cycling.
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's take it at a slow pace.
Yeah, let's take it at a slow pace.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Okay♪ Time for some stretches—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At present, Loves Only You is adjusting 
her training regimen, prioritizing 
recovery from the Queen Elizabeth II Cup 
above all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Today, we are intentionally doing light 
exercises other than running to disperse 
muscle strain and promote blood 
circulation through cross-training, but—"
choice_data_list:
(Is there anything I might have 
overlooked...?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...It is not uncommon for an Umamusume to 
unknowingly accumulate fatigue after a 
grueling race, which later leads to 
injury.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Our next goal, the trip to Hong Kong, is 
next month. Considering it'll be our first 
overseas trip, we can't overlook any 
unexpected, excessive fatigue—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I should be doing the very best I can 
right now. And yet, at the slightest 
opening, a murky anxiety spreads from deep 
within...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer-kun, are you okay?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: —Trainer-chan, are you okay?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Your brow was a little furrowed, you 
know? Just like before a race."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...If anything's bothering you, you can 
always tell me. Whatever it is, I'm always 
here to listen, Trainer-kun♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...If anything's bothering you, you can 
always tell me. Whatever it is, I'm always 
here to listen, Trainer-chan♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, next up is finally Hong 
Kong! Everyone's super excited, right?♪

text_block_list.name: Comments Section
text_block_list.text:
""Finally!" "Hong Kong, here we come!" 
"Charge~!" "Taking on the world at last!" 
"So exciting☆" "If it's Love-chan, she can 
win!""

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Uh-huh♪ Please keep giving lots of cheers 
to everyone's Loves, spreading her wings 
across the world!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...Is that so.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...I see. Then... be sure to let me know 
if anything happens, okay?♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With the path to the world open, Loves 
Only You's heart is ablaze. And her 
community members dream of her triumph.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To fulfill her dream and that of the 
community members, I served as a bridge, 
doing everything humanly possible.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, the Trainer agonized over 
whether to put a stop to it all right now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I have to make a decision. For the sake 
of Loves Only You and the community 
members who entrusted their dreams to me.

text_block_list.name: Easily Bored Girl
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... Lately, I feel like there's 
something really strange going on with 
Loves-chan and the bridge between 
worlds~...

text_block_list.name: Easily Bored Girl
text_block_list.text:
Am I the only one feeling this way~? No, 
but passionate Teacher said something 
similar in chat recently... Wait, it's a 
DM. It's from—

text_block_list.name: Easily Bored Girl
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Loves-chan!?!? What do you mean, 
"asking everyone for a favor"—
